method: Source-path review of the documented default configurations, supplemented by the prior kernel and model comparisons. This is not a new performance run of unchanged families.

affected.glm_flash_tp2: Both presets had 256-token idle prefill budgets. Their updated configurations use 2048; throughput and long-context prefill are refreshed.
affected.glm53_fp4_kv: LatentTile<kFp4> conversion changed. Both prefill and decode performance are refreshed, including plain/MTP2/MTP3.
affected.mimo: The explicit 128x128 FP8 scale-grid path above 128 rows now uses fp8w_gemm. All four documented deployments receive serving and context reruns.

unchanged.glm_flash_tp4: Already used the larger idle budget. BF16 KV does not use the changed FP4 loader; GLM has no launch_scale_gemm_grid callers.
unchanged.glm53_bf16_fp8_kv: These cache formats do not use LatentTile<kFp4>; GLM has no launch_scale_gemm_grid callers.
unchanged.qwen: No launch_scale_gemm_grid callers; does not use the changed DSA FP4 cache loader.
unchanged.deepseek_v41: Explicit scale-grid callers use rs=cs=5, outside the new rs=cs=7 branch. Its block-format cache loader is unchanged.
unchanged.deepseek_v4: Prefill dense projections use grouped MMA tiles (Dsv4AttnLayer::dense). Remaining grid calls, including draft_first, select decode_mma with supported aligned shapes before the changed dispatcher; mma_gemv_shape_ok has no upper row-count limit. Its cache loader is unchanged.
